execution.singleOwnerPolicy: Current root was active and acquired real lease. Future runs use the actual lease holder, not historical agent names.
execution.lockStatus: Query live at each run; STATE.json is not a live lock or permission token.
execution.onBusyOrUnknown: Skip current cycle with exit75; do not queue or automatically steal even expired locks.
execution.limitsNote: run enforces its child process group only. A scheduled task runner must separately enforce entire agent time/usage/concurrency. Never raise limits or disable stops automatically.
execution.evidencePolicy: Unique Artifacts/Validation/Autonomy/<run-id>; retain all historical originals/GUID/save/ZIP/failures. Raw Artifacts are ignored; durable baseline/check summaries and next work are in these committed files.
execution.continuation: Each bounded work batch ends with checkpoint and owned CAS release. Under the active long-term goal, a later independent batch rechecks actual idle/environment/remote state and acquires a new bounded lease. Never extend an active lease, steal an expired lock, increase a limit, or create/recreate a goal/schedule automatically; no overall agent budget is inferred from the child-command limit.
